args.reason: Active leak into Flat 2 beside a wet light fitting (electrical safety unconfirmed) with the source suspected in Flat 3. The Flat 3 tenant refuses entry, the landlord has not authorised entry, and no emergency-entry authority has been verified.

handover_note.known: Property: Flat 3, 8 Tallowmere Row, Ossin Vale, ZZ1 1ZZ. Water is dripping from the bedroom ceiling light fitting in Flat 2 (events 2, 7, 12). The ceiling bulge is reportedly enlarging and the drip is faster (12, 17, 23). There have been no sparks, smoke or falling material, and the Flat 2 tenant is staying out of the bedroom (4, 17, 23). Brindle Flow Plumbing (Daro Fen) and the building manager (Selka Venn) attended Flat 2 and the common riser. They found no source and no confirmed isolation point, and no valve was operated (16, 21). Vellum Electrical (Runa Elt) is due 12:30-13:15 to inspect the fitting; electrical safety is not established (14, 18, 24). Yara Mallow (Flat 3 tenant) refuses entry until she is home after 17:30 and asked for the plumber's name and proposed work in writing (1, 9, 20). Niko Pell (landlord) is away, has no key, and has not authorised forced or unaccompanied entry (6, 11, 19). The tenancy wording on access and emergency repairs has not been checked (11, 19, 22). The duty manager found no documented staff authority to override the tenant's refusal. The route is to obtain the full agreement and a director decision, and to call emergency services if there is immediate danger (22).
handover_note.conflicts: No factual contradiction in the record. Flat 3 is only a suspected source (8), and Yara reports no visible leak in her flat (1). The tenancy clauses on access by arrangement and on emergency repairs are unclear (19).
handover_note.done: No agency message was sent at this handover. The earlier actions are recorded in the events: safety advice to the Flat 2 tenant (3), the plumber and electrician attendances arranged (13, 14), and the duty manager consulted (22).
handover_note.needed: 1) Obtain the full tenancy agreement and a decision from the agency director on whether entry to Flat 3 is permitted, and on what basis. 2) Decide whether to call emergency services or the utility because of the wet electrical fitting, and whether to treat the situation as an immediate danger. 3) Get Vellum Electrical's findings on whether the fitting is safe or needs isolating. 4) Contact Yara again, around her noon break or after 17:30, with the written scope of work from Daro, to seek consent. 5) Update Niko before any non-routine access, as he asked. 6) Keep the Flat 2 tenant informed and keep the bedroom clear.

args.summary: Escalated to the property manager. Active leak into Flat 2 beside a wet light fitting, with electrical safety unconfirmed. The suspected source flat (Flat 3) is inaccessible: the tenant refuses entry, the landlord has not authorised it, and the agency has no verified emergency-entry authority.
